top_signals.title: Treasury yields hold near multiyear highs as traders await data, Fed minutes this week
top_signals.summary: U.S. Treasury yields inched lower on Monday after a sharp selloff the week prior, as investors look ahead to the Federal Reserve's last meeting minutes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
